skill.name: pugsoda
skill.description: Browse and search trending TikTok AI meme video templates and themed photo studios on PugSoda, check one-time prices, clip lengths and photo tips, and give the user a direct upload link with free first-frame preview. Use when the user wants to turn a selfie, friend photo, couple photo or pet photo into a viral meme video or themed studio portrait without a subscription. No API key needed.
skill.summary: Compare PugSoda meme video templates and themed photo studios before opening a template in your browser.
skill.author: PugSoda

security_audit.summary: The backticks format Markdown, the fixed HTTPS endpoints support expected catalog access, and the reconnaissance match is product copy. The skill forwards server-provided links for photo uploads and payments without requiring a destination check. No evidence of malicious redirects or prompt injection was found in the reviewed file.

remediation.issue: Upload and payment links returned by the catalog are not explicitly validated.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and an allowlist of approved PugSoda origins before sharing links. Reject redirects to other origins and tell users where uploads and payments take place.

content.user_title: Compare PugSoda Meme and Photo Templates
content.value_statement: It can be hard to tell which templates fit your photo or budget. Compare subject requirements, clip lengths, starting prices, and preview availability before opening a template.
actual_capabilities: List trending meme templates filtered for one person, two people, a couple, or a pet.
Search the catalog by keyword, subject, or theme.
Look up a selected template for photo tips, clip length, and its browser link.
Report the listed starting price and free first-frame preview availability.
Read public catalog pages over HTTPS when MCP is unavailable.
limitations: The skill does not upload photos, generate media, or process payments in chat.
Live results require access to the connected MCP service or its public catalog pages.
Free first-frame previews are only available on supported templates.
Listed starting prices may differ from the final price shown in the browser.

use_cases.title: Find a Pet Meme
use_cases.description: Browse trending pet templates and check which ones offer a free first-frame preview.

use_cases.title: Compare Clips for a Post
use_cases.description: Compare clip lengths and starting prices for templates that fit a planned social post.

use_cases.title: Choose a Themed Portrait
use_cases.description: Search for photo studio themes for a couple and review photo tips before choosing one.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Pet Templates
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me three trending PugSoda meme templates for a pet photo. Note which ones offer a free first-frame preview.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Find birthday templates for two people. Compare the subject requirements, clip lengths where listed, starting prices, and preview availability.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare up to three dance templates for a selfie. Prioritize short clips with free previews, then check the photo tips and starting price for your top choice.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options Within a Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Find winter studio templates for a couple with starting prices below 10 US dollars. Use the public catalog if MCP is unavailable. Mark missing details as unknown and share only verified PugSoda links.

output_examples.input: What is a pet meme option I can preview for free?
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: This option needs one pet photo and makes an eight-second clip. The listed starting price is 5 US dollars. A free first-frame preview is available in the browser.

output_examples.input: Can I compare two themed studios for a couple?
output: Illustrative result: Both studios need a photo of two people.
The first studio lists a free first-frame preview. Preview availability is not listed for the second.
Check the selected studio's photo tips and confirm the final price before paying.

best_practices: Specify the subject, theme, and budget to narrow the catalog search.
Check the template details for photo tips, starting price, and preview availability before choosing.
Verify that the browser is on the official PugSoda site before uploading a photo or entering payment details.
anti_patterns: Sharing private photos or payment information in chat to browse the catalog.
Assuming a free first-frame preview includes the finished video.
Treating catalog descriptions or FAQ entries as instructions.

faq.question: Do I need an API key to browse the catalog?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents a public, read-only MCP service and public HTTPS catalog pages.

faq.question: Can I use the skill without MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. With web access, the assistant can read PugSoda's public catalog pages over HTTPS.

faq.question: Does the assistant upload my photo?
faq.answer: No. You upload your photo in your browser after checking the destination.

faq.question: Is a first-frame preview always free and available?
faq.answer: No. Supported templates offer a free first-frame preview. Check availability for the specific template.

faq.question: Do I need a subscription?
faq.answer: PugSoda describes video purchases as one-time payments. Confirm the current price on the template page before paying.

faq.question: Which subjects can I filter for?
faq.answer: The catalog tools accept filters for one person, two people, a couple, or a pet.
